name: Grilled Portuguese sardines
assumptions: Recipe serves 4 based on 8 sardines (2 per person, standard for main course seafood dish)
Total preparation and cooking time estimated at 20 minutes (10 min active steps + 4-5 min per side grilling; chilling time excluded as not active prep)
All ingredients screened as listed; no barley/rye/wheat/oats present for gluten-free classification
No dairy, eggs, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame listed
Fish allergen present due to sardines; shellfish absent as sardines are finfish
Chilli assumed to be fresh red chilli with no compound sauce or hidden allergens
instructions:
STEP 1

Put all of the ingredients, except the sardines, into a bowl and mix together with some seasoning. Pour into a baking dish, add the sardines and toss really well. Cover and chill for a few hours.

STEP 2

Heat a BBQ or griddle pan until hot. Cook the sardines for 4-5 minutes on each side or until really caramelised and charred. Put onto a serving plate, drizzle with oil, sprinkle with a little more paprika and squeeze over the lemon wedges.

ingredients.name: Sardines
ingredients.assumptions: 8 whole fresh sardines, each ~100g raw edible weight including bones (common package size for this recipe); nutrition for raw sardines

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbs paprika = 7g (standard tablespoon for ground spice)

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 lemon = 50g with peel (typical small lemon half used for zest/juice and wedges); whole recipe usage

ingredients.name: Rosemary
ingredients.assumptions: 4 sprigs fresh rosemary = 8g (plausible small sprigs for marinade)

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 whole red chilli = 30g (medium fresh chilli, fully used in marinade)
